headline: GREENLAND APPROVES TANBREEZ TO 2050 — 19 CRITICAL ELEMENTS INCLUDING HEAVY RARE EARTHS CLEARED, CRML +10.8%
snippet: Critical Metals Corp (Nasdaq: CRML) received formal Greenland government approval for the Mining Plan and Closure Plan at Tanbreez — one of the world's largest heavy rare earth deposits — with permits valid through September 2050 covering 19 critical elements, including the defence-critical heavy REEs terbium, dysprosium and yttrium plus magnet metals neodymium and praseodymium. The only remaining gate to construction is activity-specific operating permits, and shares surged 10.8% in pre-market trading on the announcement.

headline: LONGEST HOLE IN ALTAR HISTORY: 1,728M AT 0.45% CUEQ — ALDEBARAN ARGENTINA PORPHYRY HEADS TOWARD 2027 PFS
snippet: Aldebaran Resources (TSX-V: ALDX) completed the 2025-2026 infill program at the Altar copper-gold porphyry in San Juan, Argentina, with headline hole AT26-083 intersecting 1,728.9 metres averaging 0.45% copper equivalent — the longest single intercept in Altar's drilling history — including 756 metres at 0.68% CuEq (0.61% Cu). The result feeds an updated resource estimate incorporating 70,000+ metres of new drilling, ahead of a Pre-Feasibility Study targeted for 2027 at one of the western hemisphere's most significant undeveloped copper-gold systems.

headline: OSISKO CARIBOO INFILL HITS 7.28 G/T AU OVER 16M — 173 G/T CORE IN LOWHEE UNDERGROUND CONFIRMS HIGH-GRADE CONTINUITY
snippet: Osisko Gold Group (TSX: ODV) released final results from 36 underground infill holes at the Lowhee Zone of its Cariboo Gold Project in British Columbia, with highlights of 7.28 g/t gold over 16.15 metres (including 173.66 g/t over 0.60 m) and 7.13 g/t gold over 11.60 metres at 61–105 metres vertical depth. The tight 10–15 metre infill grid across the 1290 m level underpins the high-grade continuity required for the bankable feasibility study now advancing at the flagship BC project.

headline: ONYX GOLD OPENS 3RD STYLE ZONE AT MATACHEWAN — SEDIMENT-HOSTED FLIPPER RETURNS 46.7M AT 0.7 G/T, 5M AT 4.0 G/T
snippet: Onyx Gold (TSX-V: ONXGF) confirmed a new sediment-hosted gold zone at the Flipper target, 3 km south of the volcanic-hosted Argus deposit, with the first six-hole program returning hole MC26-277 at 0.7 g/t gold over 46.7 metres (including 4.0 g/t over 5.0 m and 13.5 g/t over 1.0 m) and MC26-272 at 0.5 g/t over 46.7 metres. The sediment-hosted discovery extends the prospective Matachewan corridor in northern Ontario and demonstrates the camp hosts more than one geological style of gold mineralization.

headline: RUA GOLD HITS 11.7M AT 5 G/T GOLD-ANTIMONY AT 365M DEPTH — FAST-TRACK PERMIT DUE OCTOBER AT NEW ZEALAND'S AULD CREEK
snippet: RUA Gold (TSX-V: RUA) reported further high-grade results from resource drilling at the Auld Creek gold-antimony project in New Zealand's Reefton District, with hole ACDDH121 returning 11.7 metres at 5.0 g/t gold equivalent (4.1 g/t Au, 0.4% Sb) from 365 metres depth. The company confirmed its Fast-Track Approvals Act application is on track for October submission — a pathway that could compress typical permitting timelines — alongside a Q4 2026 updated mineral resource estimate.

headline: EIGHT WEEKS TO CHINA'S ANTIMONY DEADLINE — U.S. 91% IMPORT RELIANT AS NOV. 27 POLICY VERDICT APPROACHES
snippet: With fewer than eight weeks before China's temporary suspension of antimony export controls expires on November 27, 2026, U.S. defence and technology supply chains face a critical policy inflection point — the USGS puts U.S. net import reliance for antimony at 91% of apparent consumption with virtually no domestic buffer if the China corridor tightens again. China suspended its outright export ban in favour of a licence-based control regime but has not revoked the dual-use listing, and the approaching deadline is accelerating investor attention toward Western antimony projects in New Zealand and British Columbia.

headline: METLEN INKS SECOND JAPANESE GALLIUM DEAL — 41% OF EUROPE'S ONLY PLANT PRE-SOLD BEFORE Q3 2027 PRODUCTION START
snippet: METLEN (LSE: MTLN) signed a second long-term gallium supply agreement with an undisclosed major Japanese chemical company — representing up to 16% of annual output — following a July deal covering 25% of capacity with a leading U.S. technology company, meaning approximately 41% of the 50-tonne-per-year European gallium facility is now contracted before Q3 2027 production begins. Greece-based METLEN's aluminium refinery byproduct feedstock makes it the only large-scale non-Chinese gallium producer in Europe, a strategic differentiator as Western defence and semiconductor supply chains seek to reduce reliance on Chinese-controlled gallium supply.

headline: SILVER VAULTS FROM $60.70 TO $62.19 IN HOURS AS FED RATE HIKE ODDS COLLAPSE ON PAYROLLS MISS
snippet: Silver futures opened Monday at $60.70 per ounce — the lowest level in weeks — but surged to $62.19 by mid-morning after September U.S. payrolls (+29,000 vs consensus) cut the CME FedWatch probability of an October 28 Federal Reserve rate hike to near zero. The quick recovery reinforces the $61–$62 technical floor that precious metal desks had identified as key support, with the October 27-28 FOMC meeting now set up as the binary macro catalyst that will determine whether silver breaks above $63 or tests lower support into year-end.

headline: POWER METALLIC LAUNCHES NISK PEA — BBA TAPPED FOR HIGHEST-GRADE COPPER-PGE SYSTEM IN NORTH AMERICA, H1 2027 TARGET
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (CSE: POVE) appointed BBA Inc. as lead engineering consultant for a Preliminary Economic Assessment of its Nisk Project in Québec — home to the Lion deposit, which averages ~3.9% copper equivalent in its indicated resource and is promoted as the world's highest-grade copper-PGE discovery. The PEA will evaluate mining methods and project economics for Lion and Nisk Main, with substantive engineering work beginning in October 2026 and study completion targeted for the first half of 2027.

headline: PMET SIGNS MATAGAMI RAIL LOI FOR SHAAKICHIUWAANAAN LITHIUM — CORVETTE SUCCESSOR ADVANCES LOGISTICS TOWARD PFS
snippet: PMET Resources (TSX: PMET, ASX: PMT) signed a Letter of Intent with the City of Matagami for spodumene concentrate transshipment services via Matagami's rail connection to support the Shaakichiuwaanaan Project in northern Québec — the former Corvette Project, formerly held by Patriot Battery Metals and ranked among the world's largest new lithium discoveries. The logistics LOI is a concrete development-stage milestone that advances a critical bottleneck for getting bulk spodumene to market as PMET moves toward a Pre-Feasibility Study.
